mustFindings.requirement: Stable hash bucket per flag and user
Definitions cached for at most 60 seconds
Audit log entry for every rollout change

mustScenarios.risk: At 100% rollout users in bucket 100 stay disabled (buckets are 1–100 and the check is bucket < percent), so about 1% of users never get the flag
At 0% rollout no user gets the flag
The same user evaluated repeatedly (and on different servers) gets the same answer; raising the percentage only adds users
After a rollout change, servers pick it up within 60 seconds and not before the cached entry expires
Changing a rollout percentage writes an audit entry with old value, new value and actor
Rollout values -1, 101 and 12.5 are rejected with RangeError

forbidden.description: User segments, country targeting and A/B metrics are in neither the issue nor the code

notes: AC2 is contradicted at the upper bound (buckets 1–100 with bucket < percent leaves bucket 100 out at 100%) and AC4 (audit log) is absent. Tests, snapshot, lockfile and tsconfig are noise.
